home.hero.title: Start from a clean launch pipeline
home.hero.description: The new kernel depends only on official Mojang endpoints and cross-platform .NET. The interface uses vertical navigation, card sections and soft hierarchy, organized in the spirit of whiteboard apps without copying their layout or assets.
home.progress.title: Migration progress
home.next.title: Next steps
install.title: Choose a version to install
install.description: Only the official Mojang manifest and asset sources are used. Installation does not include PCL signing, telemetry or update logic.
install.loader.title: Install a mod loader
install.loader.description: Builds a loader version on top of an installed vanilla version. Fabric / Quilt use their Meta APIs; Forge / NeoForge use the official installers and require Java.
install.content.title: What gets installed
install.directory.title: Directory layout
install.directory.desc: Versions go under versions in the current game directory; libraries and assets go into libraries and assets.
install.directory.hint: After installation, pick the version on the Launch page.
install.loader.select: Select a vanilla version, loader and loader version
install.loader.javaRequired: Installing Forge / NeoForge requires Java. Set it in Settings or install a runtime first.
launch.config.title: Launch configuration
launch.java.watermark: Choose or detect the java executable
launch.java.hint: Leave empty to detect before launch. If no Java is available, the official Mojang runtime is downloaded and verified.
launch.license.hint: A genuine-purchase and PCL sponsorship notice is shown before launch. This is required until PCL code and assets are fully replaced.
launch.log.title: Runtime log
launch.log.subtitle: Java standard output and error output
launch.status.javaMissing: Java not found. Enter the java path manually
launch.status.needVersion: Install and select a version first
launch.status.installingJava: No system Java found. Installing the Mojang runtime…
settings.title: Game and runtime
settings.description: These settings are stored in the new kernel's own configuration file.
settings.gameDir.watermark: Directory containing versions, libraries and assets
settings.java.watermark: Leave empty to detect at launch
settings.isolation: Enable version isolation: each version uses its own game directory
settings.isolation.hint: Isolated directories live under versions/<version>/game. Deleting a version also deletes its saves and settings.
settings.accounts.title: Offline accounts
settings.accounts.description: Accounts are for offline launch only. UUIDs are derived from usernames using offline rules; no credentials are involved.
settings.accounts.hint: Click Save settings above to persist changes.
settings.env.title: Environment
settings.config.title: Configuration file
settings.config.desc: Settings are written as JSON with atomic file replacement to avoid corruption.
settings.license.title: License notice
settings.license.desc: Until PCL code and assets are fully replaced, the project keeps the PCL name prefix, About-page attribution and genuine-purchase guidance required by the license.
settings.status.added: Added offline account {0}. Save to apply
settings.error.lastAccount: Keep at least one offline account
settings.status.javaMissing: Java not found. Enter the path manually

about.license.title: License obligations
about.license.notice: Until PCL code and assets are fully replaced, this project continues to follow the PCL Limited Distribution License: keep the PCL name prefix, attribution on the About page, open source, genuine-purchase guidance and the Windows blue hue. The license notice will be adjusted only after asset replacement is complete.
about.clean.title: Clean kernel
about.clean.notice: The new PCL.Kernel is an independent implementation and does not reuse PCL signing, update, sponsorship, telemetry or localization assets.
about.support.title: Support the author and project
about.support.description: If you like this work, please buy Minecraft through official channels first. You may also sponsor the original PCL author.
license.title: Before launch
license.heading: Support genuine copies and the original PCL author
license.intro: Until PCL code and assets are fully replaced, this project follows the PCL Limited Distribution License: show genuine-purchase guidance and a sponsorship entry before launching the game.
license.purchase.hint: Minecraft requires a genuine account for the complete experience.
license.purchase.ignore: If you already own a genuine copy, you can ignore this notice.
